facts.fact: The deck says IPRS and eCitizen give real-time authentication, and connected systems include KRA tax, SHA/SHIF, education, financial-sector e-KYC, SIM registration and social protection.
The deck lists KRA tax, health insurance, education, financial e-KYC, SIM registration and social protection systems as connected to the national ID verification.
The deck says over 22,000 services are online relying on the digital ID for access.
